verdict.rationale: x402 is an open standard under Linux Foundation governance with a public npm SDK, and sellers run the payment-gating middleware on their own resource servers. Community builders (Apiosk, httpay) report running x402 endpoints and gateways themselves. However, the core verification and settlement component is documented only as the hosted, API-key-gated CDP Facilitator, and nothing in the pack shows a self-hostable facilitator. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted facilitator (verify/settle) deployment, self-hosting guides or deployment artifacts, and independent hands-on reports of fully self-hosted operation.
